options.why: The last strictly smaller bound describes the preceding tier boundary, not bisect_left's returned insertion index.
bisect_left finds the first bound at least V, or len(bounds) beyond all bounds, identifying the applicable tier.
Smaller volumes can lie in an earlier tier; the unbounded final tier is used only beyond the last bound.
The search compares sorted volume bounds, not rate magnitudes.

items.explanation: Earlier tiers are full; the current tier is partially or fully used. Beyond all finite bounds, use the final unbounded tier.
